text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On a day off, I spotted Silence Suzuka and 
the others at a sports shop in the 
shopping mall.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
All righty! We're here! The promised land 
of Shangri-La!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
What on earth are you talking about desu 
wa... We all came here specifically to 
help choose shoes for Suzuka-san, so 
please do not forget our goal.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka-san, do you have any particular 
preferences when choosing shoes desu ne?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... What I pay attention to first 
is checking the size properly, I suppose. 
And after that, actually trying them on――

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I prefer softer materials... Also, I want 
to value the feel of the ground, so 
thinner soles... And then, um――

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
A-As expected of Suzuka-san...! Your shoe 
preferences are wicked detailed――

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oho?! Check this out, it's freakin' 
amazing!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Take a look at these kicks! It's a 
legendary-tier treasure!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, aren't these roller skates desu 
wa?! They even have weird wings attached 
at the ankles?!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...How do you use these?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Eh?! Suzuka-san, you don't know what 
roller skates are?!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, it's not that, but... I just don't 
know what kind of training effect wearing 
these would have... I guess.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
C'mon man, feel it with pure passion! Look 
at these wings. You'll definitely see an 
insane view, like soarin' straight into 
the heavens~...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: An insane... view...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Since we're here anyway, it 
wouldn't hurt to try them on for the heck 
of it! Right, McQueen-san!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Eh?! ...Well... I suppose it is fine, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ............ Just for a little bit, then.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Just like that, Silence Suzuka slowly 
slid forward... and before long, turned 
around the shop aisle corner...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...U-Um. How... do you stop this 
thing...?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: S-Suzuka-san?! Please wait desu wa~~!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
*pant* *pant*... That was close...! When 
Suzuka-san accelerated down the slope, 
leaped high, and did three vertical 
rotations in midair, I thought it was 
over...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Who would've thought she packed that much 
power... ...Looks like we unleashed a 
forbidden seal, Spe, McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
You were the one who suggested it in the 
first place! Honestly... I am terribly 
sorry, Suzuka-san.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
No, it's fine. In fact, flailing around 
like that was... kind of funny. Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Th-Thank goodness~! So you actually 
had fun then!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Being with everyone is really so 
much fun. Truly...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
All right~! Then riding on this fun 
momentum, let's all happily pick out the 
absolute perfect shoes for Suzuka-san 
together~!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Thank you. Well then, shall we go――

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Oho! Check it! Found another hidden gem!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
You're picking weird things again... 
――Wait, this time it's an actual, sensible 
shoe desu wa...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Well duh. When it comes to pickin' 
shoes, softer materials and slightly 
thinner soles are the basics, y'know...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That is literally word for word what 
Suzuka-san said at the beginning desu wa!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Suzuka-san, please come over here! 
This one looks like the perfect size, plus 
it's got a cute carrot mark on it――

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Fufu, yes. I'm coming now.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Having so many different kinds of 
shoes... If I was alone, I probably never 
would have noticed. ――Because I'm here 
with everyone...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
――Fufu. Now I really want to find out. 
With the shoes everyone chose for me... 
what kind of "view" I'll be able to see.
